title: Restricted sections inclusion factors through the filtered step
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $K$ a bounded-below cochain complex of abelian sheaves on its small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $T$ an étale termwise hypercohomology presentation of $K$ [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation]. Let $q$ be any integer. The fixed map $s_q:\Gamma R_q\to\operatorname{Tot}(\Gamma T.I)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-restricted-total-construction] factors through the subobject $(T.L).\mathrm{step}(q)$.

source.place: Proof remark (3) and finite-diagonal comparison; Tag 0133, augmented-total quasi-isomorphism

proof.text: Let R be the restricted mapped bicomplex and J the full one. A summand of R in bidegree (r,s) vanishes for r<0 or s<q. Otherwise r+s=n implies q≤s≤n, so the J diagonal inclusion has image below the finite supremum defining the second-filtration step. The total-map coprojection formula and T.filtration_formula give a factorization of each R coprojection through T.L.complexStep q n. The totalDesc universal property gives a factorization of the degree-n mapped-total inclusion. Since each component of the step inclusion is monic, its image is its represented subobject; transport the factors to the actual step components. Cancel these monomorphisms to check the chain-map equations. Finally precompose the resulting factorization of complexes with the inverse finite-diagonal sections comparison. Zero summands include every empty diagonal, for arbitrary integer q.
